# JavaScript: The site is obfuscated with JavaScript.
# Login: You must set up an account and login with a password.
# Malware: Chrome or Firefox accuses this site of listing malware.
# Multiple: You may submit multiple PADs at once.
# NoAuto: They explicitly ask you not to use any automation in PAD submission.
# NoLogo: They have not customised their site with a logo.
# NoProbe: You must resubmit after every version change because they fail to periodically probe your PAD for changes.
# NoSubmissionPage: Cannot find PAD submission page.
# NotAccepting: Not currently accepting PAD submissions.
# Notify: They notify you by email when they notice your PAD or the files it references change or become inaccessible.
# NotResponding: Not Responding and domain abandoned.
# Obfuscated: Obfuscated to deter automated submission.
# OldSpec: They support only an obsolete (pre 3.0) versionof the PAD spec.
# PADmaps: They support the PADmaps protocol so that submitting one PAD submits your whole catalog.
# PADRING: They support the PADRING protocol so that submitting one PAD submits your whole catalog.
# Parked: Site parked and domain abandoned.
# Pay: You must pay to list.
# Prefill: You press a PREFILL button to display the contents of the PAD and then you edit the fields before final submission.
# Propagate: They pass the PADs you submit to other PADSites.
# Proprietary: You must select a proprietary category for the PAD.
# RegNow: Only software sold via RegNow/Bluesnap (née Plimus)/eSellerate etc.
# Rekey: You must manually rekey some of the fields in the PAD.
# Resurrected: Site was off the air for a while
# Scavenger: You may not even have to submit your PAD to them. They go out scouring the web for PADs.
# Skill: You must answer a skill-testing question.
# Slow: Site is unusually slow to respond. Please be patient.
# Stalls: Stalls ignoring timeout when Java probes the site.
# Strict: They have their own stricter-than-ASP standards for validating PADs.
# Upload: You don’t submit an URL
